from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAssetReport(BaseModel):
    """Financial asset data extracted from a single company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as identified in the filing")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The time period covered by the report (e.g. 'March 31, 2024')")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact name of the asset line item reported (e.g., 'Total Current Assets', 'Total Assets')")
    reported_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value as written in the document (e.g. 16970)")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the value (e.g. 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the asset figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    asset_reports: list[CompanyAssetReport]
